tips: Start with short sentences — you don't need to be perfect, you just need to start.
Just 10 minutes of speaking a day adds up to nearly an hour of practice a week.
Mistakes are part of learning — AI will explain yours in simple words.
Practise listening and speaking together and you'll improve much faster.
